Phoenix, Arizona · stay

Hotels in Phoenix for cyclists

Where to sleep in Phoenix when you’re here to ride. Book early for event weekends.

Hotels in Phoenix for cyclists, listed

6 picks · ask about the bike when you book.

  1. Sonesta Suites Scottsdale Gainey Ranch

    Scottsdale, at Gainey Ranch, about 11 miles northeast of downtown Phoenix.

    • 7300 E Gainey Suites Drive, Scottsdale, AZ 85258
    • $$
    • Bike: No stated policy. Ask when you book.

    Nearby ride: Gainey Tuesday (Flat Route) (Tuesdays, 5:30 am); Gainey Thursday (Thursdays, 5:30 am); The Saturday Ride (Fuss Buss) (Saturdays, 6:00 am) →

    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Sonesta Suites Scottsdale Gainey Ranch

    Its own page puts the Gainey Village Health Club 0.3 mile away, and Scottsdale Cycling’s rides: Gainey Tuesday (Flat Route) (Tuesdays, 5:30 am); Gainey Thursday (Thursdays, 5:30 am); The Saturday Ride (Fuss Buss) (Saturdays, 6:00 am) leave from Scottsdale Rd and Doubletree Ranch Rd at Gainey Village. Every suite has a full kitchen, which matters on a training week; breakfast runs 7 to 9, after those rides have left. A $30 plus tax a night destination fee that includes parking (the hotel’s page, Oct 2026); about $159 for a late-October Sunday on hotels.com (read Oct 3, 2026). Nothing about your own bike on its pages.

  2. Grand Hyatt Scottsdale Resort

    • 7500 E. Doubletree Ranch Road, Scottsdale, AZ 85258
    • Bike: No stated policy. Ask when you book.

    Nearby ride: Gainey Tuesday (Flat Route) (Tuesdays, 5:30 am); Gainey Thursday (Thursdays, 5:30 am); The Saturday Ride (Fuss Buss) (Saturdays, 6:00 am) →

    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Grand Hyatt Scottsdale Resort

    Scottsdale, at Gainey Ranch, on Doubletree Ranch Rd, the road the Gainey Village rides: Gainey Tuesday (Flat Route) (Tuesdays, 5:30 am); Gainey Thursday (Thursdays, 5:30 am); The Saturday Ride (Fuss Buss) (Saturdays, 6:00 am) start on. It was the Hyatt Regency until a 2024 renovation. The $55 nightly resort fee includes bicycle rentals; those are the resort’s bikes, and nothing on its pages covers yours. No rate shown (Oct 2026).

  3. Hampton Inn & Suites Phoenix Tempe

    • 1415 N. Scottsdale Road, Tempe, AZ 85288
    • $$
    • Bike: No stated policy. Ask when you book.

    Nearby ride: Regroup Saturday Coffee Ride (Saturdays, 6:30 am) →

    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Hampton Inn & Suites Phoenix Tempe

    North Tempe, about 8 miles east of downtown Phoenix, on the same road as Regroup Coffee + Bicycles, where the Regroup coffee ride (Saturdays, 6:30 am) leaves. Free hot breakfast and free self-parking; no airport shuttle. Nothing about bikes on the hotel’s pages. $100 to $139 a night on trivago for October nights, and $417 for Saturday, Nov 7 (read Oct 3, 2026), so read a date before you count on the price.

  4. Tempe Mission Palms

    Downtown Tempe, beside A Mountain and “just steps from Mill Avenue,” by its own page.

    • 60 E 5th St, Tempe, AZ 85281
    • Bike: No stated policy. Ask when you book.
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Tempe Mission Palms

    The $30 nightly destination fee covers parking and a shuttle to and from Sky Harbor, 5:30 a.m. to 10 p.m.; ask at booking whether the shuttle takes a bike case. It has a rooftop pool. Nothing about bikes on its pages, and no rate shown (Oct 2026).

  5. Phoenix Hostel & Cultural Center

    Central Phoenix, just northeast of downtown.

    • 1026 N. 9th Street, Phoenix, AZ 85006
    • $
    • Bike: No stated policy. Ask when you book.

    Nearby ride: Phoenix Downtempo Ride (Mondays, 8:00 pm) →

    BookDirectionsWebsite
    More about Phoenix Hostel & Cultural Center

    Its page puts the light rail at Central and Roosevelt a mile’s walk away, and the Downtempo ride (Mondays, 8:00 pm) leaves from Civic Space Park downtown. Private rooms $60 to $80 a night for one or two (the hostel’s page, Oct 2026). Self check-in at any hour, free street parking. Guests need a government ID and must live outside Maricopa County. Hostelworld lists the same address as HI Phoenix – The Metcalf House. Nothing about bikes on its pages.

  6. Arizona Biltmore

    • 2400 E. Missouri Ave, Phoenix, AZ 85016
    • Bike: No stated policy. Ask when you book.

    Nearby ride: Granada Sunday Breakfast Ride (Sundays, 6:30 am) →

    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Arizona Biltmore

    Central Phoenix, at 24th St and Missouri in the Biltmore area. PMBC’s breakfast ride (Sundays, 6:30 am) leaves Granada Park at 20th St and Maryland, about 6 miles north of downtown. The $45 nightly resort charge includes a one-hour bike rental; nothing on its pages covers your own bike. Parking is $28 a night self, $35 valet. No rate shown (Oct 2026).
